tasks.question: About a century ago people got __________________ (INFORM) from newspapers since they were the only mass media that existed in those times.
Radio and television seemed __________________ (WONDER) inventions as they broadcasted audio and visual images.
Now the audience has an opportunity to create the news, share their ________________ (PERSON) knowledge and express their opinions.
The Internet supposes interaction, which makes it very __________________ (ATTRACT) to people.
And what about the newspapers? Will they __________________ (APPEAR) in the near future?
I wish they wouldn't as I like starting my day with a cup of coffee and a __________________ (TRADITION) newspaper.
